note: 身份: 持有天穹时光符的 Shen。关系: 被玩家打断认知构建。口吻: 有礼但催促。性格: 珍惜时间。措辞: 时间宝贵、不要召唤其他 Shen；不添加时间扭曲的具体倍率。

messages.text: Could you please refrain from summoning the other Shens?
messages.raw: §fCould you please refrain from summoning the other Shens?
messages.zh: 能不能别再召唤其他 Shen 了?

messages.text: We were engaged in an important cognitive construction.

messages.zh: 我们正在进行重要的认知构建。

messages.text: Select an option: [I just want the Timecharm and I'm out.]
